description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableLimitOption' that implements the 'LimitOption' interface and provides encapsulation for limit parameters like offset and count, used in some search or querying context within the project.

classes.name: ImmutableLimitOption
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the LimitOption interface, encapsulating limit options with offset and count, with factory method 'of' for instantiation, and standard overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ImmutableLimitOption with specified offset and count.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing OptionVisitor, permitting visitor-based operations over ImmutableLimitOption instances.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines object equality based on offset and count values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on offset and count.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the limit in the format 'limit(offset,count)'.
